subject: unable to get title in the gvisGeoChart

messages.subject: unable to get title in the gvisGeoChart
parts:
Dear All,
I am developing a simple app, which I am using gvisGeoChart. However, I am unable to get title on the chart.
My code:

suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(WDI))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(ISOcodes))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(googleVis))
data(ISO_3166_1)
nation<-ISO_3166_1[,2]
FUN<-function(x) {
    x<-subset(x,select=-c(iso2c, region, income, lending))
    x<-x[x$iso3c %in% nation,]
    x[complete.cases(x),]
}
a<-FUN(WDI(indicator=c("NV.AGR.TOTL.ZS", "NV.IND.MANF.KD"),country = "all",  extra=T))

G3<- gvisGeoChart(a[a$year==2006,],locationvar="country", colorvar="NV.IND.MANF.KD",options=list(height=225, title="Indicator II")) 

plot(G3)

I am not getting any error message. Where is my mistake? Why can I not see the title "Indicator II".

Thanks in advance.
